    Provider_Name: 'Service Control Manager'
    EventID: 7045
selection_service:
    - ServiceName|contains|all:
          - 'AnyDesk' # Covers both AnyDesk Service and AnyDesk MSI Service
          - 'Service'
    - ImagePath|contains: 'AnyDesk'
condition: all of selection_*
